clauses.quote: Teachers will be provided a copy of the documentation of all formal observations prior to the end of the school year.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; management duty to provide documentation benefits teachers.

clauses.quote: A teacher shall be given a copy of his/her final evaluation promptly following the final evaluation conference between the teacher and the rating officer.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; management duty to deliver final evaluation.

clauses.quote: The copy, which includes the signature of the reviewing officer, shall be given to the teacher promptly after the evaluation year but not later than September 30 of that calendar year.
clauses.subject_text: The copy, which includes the signature of the reviewing officer
clauses.notes: Passive construction with explicit timing constraint on delivery.

clauses.quote: Copies of the evaluation process shall be made available to each teacher.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; management obligation to ensure accessibility.

clauses.quote: To that end, DCPS shall develop and implement professional development for all Teachers on the evaluation process.
clauses.notes: Explicit contractual obligation to provide targeted training.

clauses.quote: DCPS’s compliance with the evaluation process, and not the evaluation judgment, shall be subject to the grievance and arbitration procedure.
clauses.subject_text: DCPS’s compliance with the evaluation process, and not the evaluation judgment
clauses.notes: Limits grievable subject matter to procedural compliance, shielding evaluative judgments from challenge.

clauses.quote: The standard for separation under the evaluation process shall be “just cause,” which shall be defined as adherence to the evaluation process only.
clauses.subject_text: The standard for separation under the evaluation process
clauses.notes: Contractual definition restricting "just cause" strictly to procedural adherence, protecting management from substantive review.

clauses.quote: Employees maintain their rights to appeal below average or unsatisfactory performance evaluations pursuant to Title 5 of the DCMR, Sections 1306.8-1306.13.1
clauses.notes: Affirms and preserves existing statutory appeal rights.

clauses.quote: If a Teacher decides to challenge an alleged violation of the evaluation process, s/he has the option to request mediation at Step 1 or to commence a grievance at Step 2.
clauses.notes: Grants discretionary procedural choice to the employee.

clauses.quote: If the alleged violation occurs in connection with an evaluation that results in termination, the hearing at Step 2 shall receive priority over all other pending grievances except those related to termination.
clauses.notes: Procedural priority benefit for termination-related grievances; implicitly managed by administration/arbitrator.

clauses.quote: The commitments in Section 15.2 above shall in no way constitute a limitation on DCPS’s authority over the evaluation process and instruments as described in section 15.1 above.
clauses.notes: Reservation of management rights clause; explicitly preserves administrative authority.

clauses.quote: Interruption of the scheduled program of instruction during the day shall be kept at a minimum.
clauses.subject_text: Interruption of the scheduled program of instruction during the day
clauses.notes: Passive construction; management duty to minimize instructional disruptions.

clauses.quote: In buildings where no central communication system is in operation, routine announcements shall be posted on the bulletin board, published in the daily bulletin, or shall be sent to teachers at scheduled times previously agreed upon by the Supervisor and the School Chapter Advisory Committee.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; alternative mandatory communication methods when central systems fail.

clauses.quote: 1306.8 Employees shall have the right to appeal below average or unsatisfactory performance evaluations.
clauses.notes: Statutory provision excerpted in contract footnote; explicitly grants appeal rights.
